---
title: "📺 Getting started with R"
subtitle: "A ten-part video series to get your machine ready"
---

Work through these in order before the data-wrangling topic. Together they take
about an hour. All of them are in the course
[YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdj1QiW6P2TcEm0cn1eB6CBQQWLMthjYY).

## Required

| `hw00-02` | 📺 [R and RStudio: introduction and interface](https://youtu.be/tYdZT62-hio) | 1:36 |

| `hw00-06` | 📺 [`.R` scripts: create, modify, run, save](https://youtu.be/y0TzG4ohLJI) | 4:34 |

### `hw00-08` Write your own script {#hw00-08}

No video for this one. Take the **Ceteris Paribus** example from the
[introduction slides](/slides/00-introduction/00-introduction.html) and rebuild
it yourself as an `.R` script: load the data, reproduce the comparison, and save
the file in the project you created in `hw00-04`.
